messages.author: c0044c1e5488f5fd
messages.subject: constituent genotypes
parts:
hello
I wonder if the AA genotype stands for the 1st parent I input to the analysis
and is it constituent for all markers?
I mean, if I see that marker with genotype AA is responsible for resistance phenotype (info from the effect plot) and the 1st parent is susceptible, does it make sense? even though I input the susceptible parent first?

In addition, another resistance phenotype is related to the 1st susceptible parent. Does it mean that the SNPs are not constituent with the parents?
In one case it can be AA that came from the 1st parent and in another case BB that came from the 1st parent?

thanks
Nataly

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: constituent genotypes
parts:
It’s assumed that AA corresponds to one inbred parent and  BB to the other, but this
is something set up by the user in the data, so you should know if this is true for your
data or not.

karl
